from pathlib import Path
import json,csv,collections,hashlib
base=Path("research_registry/proposals/laufenberg_f85r2_20260926/source_supply_20260929")
sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
review=json.loads((base/"FT_POSTREVIEW.json").read_text())
a=json.loads((base/"FT_AUTHOR_COMPONENT.json").read_text())
b=json.loads((base/"FT_AUTHOR_PROCEDURE.json").read_text())
s=json.loads((base/"FT_SOURCE_PACKET.json").read_text())
with (base/"FT_PROCEDURE_DERIVATION.tsv").open() as f:rows=list(csv.DictReader(f,delimiter="\t"))
assert all(sha(r["path"])==r["expected_sha256"] for r in review["inputs"])
assert all(sha(base/n)==h for n,h in review["critic_contract_sha256"].items())
source={g["source_group_id"]:dict(g,unit_id=c["unit_id"]) for c in s["contexts"] for g in c["groups"]}
am={r["source_group_id"]:r for r in a["group_ledger"]};bm={r["source_group_id"]:r for r in rows}
assert len(source)==len(am)==len(bm)==len(rows)==len(a["group_ledger"])==655
for who,raw in [(am,"raw"),(bm,"raw_group")]:
 assert set(who)==set(source)
 assert all(r[raw]==source[k]["ivtff_group_raw"] and all(r[v]==source[k][v] for v in ["locus","left_separator","right_separator"]) for k,r in who.items())
count=0
for context in s["contexts"]:
 previous=None
 for g in context["groups"]:
  r=am[g["source_group_id"]]
  if r["status"]!="C0_AUTHORED_DERIVATION":continue
  count+=1;before=r["state_before"];after=r["state_after"];delta=r["state_delta"]
  assert previous is None or before==previous
  previous=after
  assert after["eventIds"]==before["eventIds"]+[e["id"] for e in delta["events_added"]]
  assert after["assertionCount"]==before["assertionCount"]+len(delta["assertions_added"])
  available=set(before["availableComponentParents"])|set(before["availableFluidKinds"])|set(delta["introduced_components"])|set(delta["introduced_fluids"])
  assert all(arg in available for e in delta["events_added"]+delta["assertions_added"] for arg in e["arguments"] if isinstance(arg,str) and (arg.startswith("C") or arg.startswith("F:")))
assert count==364
bd={r["whole_form"]:r for r in b["semantic_whole_definitions"]}
assert all(r["definition_id"]==bd[r["raw_group"]]["definition_id"] for r in rows if r["definition_id"] and r["definition_id"]!="UNKNOWN" and r["raw_group"] in bd)
assert not any(r["individual_effect_C0"] or r["construction_checkpoint_emitted_here"] for r in rows if r["status"] in ["UNKNOWN","KNOWN_BUT_BLOCKED"])
for lower,expected in [(False,43),(True,23)]:
 repeated=set()
 for edition in ["ZL3b","IT2a","RF1b"]:
  counts=collections.Counter(g["ivtff_group_raw"] for g in source.values() if g["edition"]==edition and (not lower or g["unit_id"].startswith("F83")))
  repeated.update(k for k,v in counts.items() if v>1)
 assert len(repeated)==expected
assert hashlib.sha256((base/"FT_AUTHOR_GO.md").read_bytes()+b"\n").hexdigest()=="a98ce80aa38b8f509a4fe6ae0c7bbbfbb3a26e6a2a516562e65071d80373e119"
